zh-CN.title: 小程序通讯与导航视觉优化
items: 四个主页面采用更醒目的标题、呼吸灯与统一浅色主操作按钮
好友申请和群聊页面按桌面端结构重排，通讯头像、入口图标与菜单退出按钮显示更准确

en.title: Improved mini program navigation and contacts
items: All four main pages now use clearer titles, a larger chat status light, and consistent pale primary actions
Friend requests and group chats now follow the desktop layout, with cleaner avatars and corrected icon and logout alignment
